text: Use 10W40 API SN, JASO MA2 semi synthetic engine oil. For an oil change with a new oil filter, the refill is 2.1 L. Watch out: Using the wrong oil grade reduces the life of the moving parts and can seriously affect performance. The 2.4 L figure is the first dry fill, not the oil-change amount. The manual says these values are approximate and the actual capacity will vary.
